key_insight: WILLIE unifies wound classification, segmentation, and localization into one multi-task framework, and the best model performs strongly across all three tasks in a single forward pass.
clinical_relevance: A shared wound-analysis pipeline could streamline assessment workflows by supporting wound type identification, boundary tracing, and region localization together.
method: Harmonized 3 public wound datasets into one benchmark
Compared unified models at 3 scaling configurations
evidence_signal: The best model reported 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 across the benchmark.
watch_item: Results come from a harmonized benchmark, so performance may not transfer directly to other wound datasets, imaging settings, or clinical workflows without further validation.
paper_title: WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization
